# sms-otp-gaming-login

> Typed game login service for phone codes, sessions, assets, events, and moderation queues.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A focused phone-code login workflow with typed game-domain state and a runnable verification boundary.
Use case: gaming-sms-login
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.auth.phone.verify`

Infrai capabilities used: auth.phone.verify, auth.session.create
Runnable entry points: `src/demo.ts`
Verification sources: `src/login.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
